West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari Addresses Governance and Political Issues

West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari has been involved in several public statements and actions concerning the state's governance. He has addressed civil service officers, reviewed the performance of the BJP government, and called for a new governance model. Adhikari has also commented on issues like crime, building safety, and a proposed hospital project, while facing accusations of political intimidation from opposition figures.
